founderRequest: FINAL AUTONOMY DIRECTIVE 2026-09-29: the repository-native supervisor UASCO-Autonomous-Supervisor becomes the primary unattended executor through Windows Task Scheduler -> narrow local launcher -> durable loop; triggers logon, startup when applicable, periodic heartbeat, restart-on-failure; narrowest privileges; the supervisor stays alive, enters WAITING and sleeps until the nearest provider retry, dependency event, queued job or heartbeat; Claude builder through the local CLI via the constrained broker, Codex through the isolated broker; permissions only from exact command contracts; signing only through ssh-agent, otherwise WAITING_FOR_SECURE_SIGNER; the routine becomes an optional watchdog and the system must work with all routines disabled; preserve the current queue; tests A-K; tests, adversarial tests, canonical and fresh-clone validation and a supervisor lifecycle test; commit; Codex review; only after CLEAN register, verify heartbeat, single-worker lock, durable queue recovery, Claude builder invocation and Codex reviewer invocation, then mark orchestration ACTIVE.

founderAuthorization.rule: [Permission 2026-09-29, verbatim] İzni veriyorum. Ancak izin yalnızca bu autonomy-hardening paketinin repo içindeki dosyalarını ve önceden tanımlanmış exact command contracts kapsamını kapsasın. Şunlara blanket/genel izin VERME: arbitrary Bash / PowerShell / cmd, repo dışına yazma, credential export, signing private key erişimi, force push, trust/security policy weakening, bilinmeyen external network işlemleri. [Directive] Implement this as the autonomy-hardening package; only request Founder interaction for a genuinely new security/authority boundary or an unavoidable one-time OS-level privilege operation.
founderAuthorization.constraint: Repository files of the autonomy-hardening package and exact command contracts only; no arbitrary shell, no writes outside the repository by the package code other than the policy control root, no credential export, no private-key access, no force push, no trust/security policy weakening, no unknown external network operations; every change keeps or strengthens fail-closed behaviour, Global Stop, reviewer isolation and evidence requirements; UNKNOWN/NOT_TESTED is never reported as PASS.

design.daemon: automation/lib/orchestrator-daemon.mjs: nextWake (ready work 0, provider retryAfter, package/release notBefore, heartbeat; capped by maxSleep; Founder-pending items ignored), runDaemon (trust root and Global Stop before each shared tick, WAITING heartbeat, idle retry instead of spinning), createSleeper (timer-only heartbeat; wake file and Global Stop wake immediately; its own heartbeat writes cannot wake it), createTick (shared by --tick, --daemon and tests; Global Stop checked before every action and command)
design.launcher: scripts/uasco-supervisor-launcher.mjs: one fixed daemon command without a shell; bounded backoff 5/15/60/300/600 s, reset after 10 healthy minutes, 6 restarts per hour then hand-over to the periodic trigger; exit 0/2/3 (clean stop, fatal, already running) not restarted; bounded log rotation
design.scheduledTask: scripts/register-orchestrator-autostart.ps1: UASCO-Autonomous-Supervisor, logon + periodic heartbeat triggers, IgnoreNew, no time limit, restart 3x/1 min, RunLevel Limited, Interactive; startup trigger only for an elevated registration as S4U without a stored password (otherwise NOT_APPLICABLE); refuses to overwrite a same-named task of another program; verifies the control-plane trust root first
design.cli: scripts/uasco-orchestrator.mjs: --daemon (exit 0/2/3), --self-check [--with-provider-smoke] (daemon policy, durable queue and log, live heartbeat, single-worker lock enforced by the live daemon, builder boundary, provider CLI resolution, real builder/reviewer invocation only with the smoke flag, else NOT_TESTED), --status reports the supervisor
design.crashAdoption: builderRound writes a round marker after committing; after a crash the committed round is adopted (fetched from the implementation clone if it never reached the branch) without a second builder call or commit
design.gitIsolation: Git contract isolation (isolatedGitArgs/isolatedGitEnv, GIT_CONFIG_PARAMETERS removal, disabled automatic signing) is provided by PKG-AUT1B cycle 2 (f3b4ad8); this package keeps it unchanged.
design.installedSystem: Phase0 runs install.ps1 -SkipAutoStart and registers the installed system's own autostart as UASCO-Installed-Supervisor through a new exact contract (idempotent, recorded with the accepted Phase0), so it can never replace the construction supervisor task; the Founder-approved installed autostart is still registered after CLEAN/CLEAN_LOCAL_ONLY, only under a distinct name
design.routine: the Claude app routine is a passive display only: it runs no command and only reads WATCHDOG_STATUS.json; the supervisor has no dependency on it (test B also scans automation/lib/watchdog-status.mjs).
design.watchdogStatus: automation/lib/watchdog-status.mjs + scripts/uasco-orchestrator.mjs: every daemon heartbeat (and every single tick) writes .ai/runtime/WATCHDOG_STATUS.json atomically (writeJsonAtomic) with the Founder's fields and an overall health derived only from real signals (HEALTHY, WAITING_PROVIDER, FOUNDER_DECISION_REQUIRED, STOPPED, UNHEALTHY; an unknown or stale heartbeat or a broken transition log is never healthy); discovery runs through new read-only contracts git.listBranchHeads, git.worktreeList and ps.scheduledTaskInfo (a fixed, locale-independent Get-ScheduledTask query limited to the two policy task names) plus git.revParse, the verified transition log and the provider state; it refreshes every 5 minutes and after each tick, a failed probe is reported UNAVAILABLE; a write failure is logged and never blocks execution; --status returns the artifact and --self-check verifies it is fresh and written by the live daemon.
design.wakeBaseline: a wake request written while a tick runs or while the heartbeat and status are written is not lost: runDaemon records the wake-file time when the tick starts and the sleeper uses it as its baseline (found when the status write widened the window between the WAITING heartbeat and the sleep; scenario A timed out before the fix).

rules: The Claude routine executes zero shell, PowerShell, cmd or Bash commands, never calls git or schtasks, never mutates repository or orchestration state, performs no reviews, starts no Claude/Codex workers, repairs nothing and is not required for UASCO execution.

The repository-native UASCO-Autonomous-Supervisor is the only executor: Windows Task Scheduler -> UASCO-Autonomous-Supervisor -> durable repo state -> Claude CLI builder -> validation -> Codex CLI reviewer -> remediation/merge -> release/signing/Phase0.

The local supervisor maintains a passive status artifact .ai/runtime/WATCHDOG_STATUS.json atomically with: supervisor status, heartbeat, current master, active package, implementation queue count, review queue count, blocked lanes, Codex quota/retry status, signer status, Phase0 status, last successful action, next scheduled action, current Founder decisions and overall health.
The supervisor performs all state discovery the routine used to perform (git refs, worktrees, scheduler status, transition log, provider retry state) and persists it into WATCHDOG_STATUS.json.

The routine may only read that artifact and summarize it; if reading it would need an interactive permission it takes no action. Command-executing behaviour in the routine is disabled and must not be approved again.
